correctness.rationale: A4 is the order-12 semidirect product of four even signed diagonal matrices and the 3-cycle. Summing projectors gives exactly 4I. For any generator the operator frame has trace 12 and fixed identity eigenvalue 4; thus the smallest eigenvalue at most 1 and condition number at least 2. The six-dimensional symmetric tensor square splits into three trivial-sign diagonal coordinates and three distinct-character cross coordinates; exact averaging gives diagonal-sector invariants Q/3 and U/3 and cross-sector scalar (1-Q)/3. Comparison with I_6/6 yields an iff characterization Q=1/2, U=0. The explicit normalized seed has Q=1/2 and U=0 exactly; the full second moment I+F establishes eigenvalues 4 and eight 1, reconstruction and all equality cases. Standalone SymPy checker replays 34 exact matrix assertions on three unrelated test vectors and the explicit fiducial; universal steps are proved, not inferred from tests.

value.rationale: The natural order-12 irreducible tetrahedral rotation-group orbit offers a minimal (among orbit sizes of this group) informationally complete Hermitian qutrit measurement ensemble. Exact all-generator classification and sharp achievable reconstruction conditioning are structurally useful; the non-MUB algebraic optimal design supplies a distinct concrete benchmark, not merely a trivial normalization or a numerical existence observation.
